## Migrator.fresh() method

Drop every table and migrate from scratch.

**Signature:**

```typescript
fresh(): Promise<string[]>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;string\[\]&gt;

Names of the migrations applied afterwards.

## Remarks

Destroys all data in the database, including the tracking table, and never calls a migration's `down`<!-- -->. Intended for development and test databases.
